race.comment: The race has basically been presented to SEMANTICS (11) with most of those who looked her key dangers coming out at scratching time. The Godolphin filly lived up to the raps with a mighty impressive maiden win last time out, scoring by 1.3 lengths over 1000m at Bendigo. She looks destined for better races than this, but that's reflected in the price. BEL LUPA (8) disappointed first-up at Seymour, but she started hard in the market that day off a couple of impressive trial wins, so might be worth forgiving her for that. SKJALDMO (7) turned in a fine effort to win by one length at this track and distance when first-up from a spell last time out. Up in grade, but looks to have upside. DU CLISSON (3) was turned out after a plain run at Caulfield and has had three trials in preparation for the return, placing in each, so she might show up fresh.
